description: Create an offline pixel-style task list. Input ID todo-input, add button ID todo-add. Show integer-only total task count in #todo-total and incomplete task count in #remaining, both initially 0. First task gets text span #todo-text-1, checkbox #todo-check-1, and delete button #todo-delete-1. Adding trims text; blank input adds nothing. Toggling checkbox updates incomplete count; deleting removes task and updates both counts. New tasks get increasing numeric IDs. Keep all state in memory, no storage. Include labels and README. HTML/CSS/JS only, under 240 source lines.
